row.label: Rule {{index}}, outbound {{target}}
row.unconditional: no conditions — applies to all traffic
row.unknown: conditions are not shown — the schema does not know this rule

hits.window: Hit count covers {{age}} since metaboxd started; a restart resets it
hits.mismatch: sing-box runs a different config — hit count is not shown
hits.edited: • — rule changed in the draft; only the applied one has a count
hits.unobserved: “not seen” — sing-box does not list such connections: sniff and resolve do not stop matching, hijacked DNS and reject never reach the connection list
